prompts.title: Cinematic Anamorphic Drone Sequence
prompts.body: Generate a slow-motion 24fps cinematic FPV drone tracking shot gliding through a mist-covered brutalist concrete canyon at blue hour. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF with Atlas Orion 40mm anamorphic lens, subtle horizontal amber lens flare, volumetric fog diffusing warm tungsten architectural spotlights, hyper-detailed wet concrete reflections, natural film grain.

prompts.title: TypeScript Zero-Dependency State Store Architect
prompts.body: Act as a Principal Frontend Architect. Design a type-safe, zero-dependency reactive state store in TypeScript (< 120 lines) supporting selector-based subscriptions, structural equality checks, middleware hooks, and LocalStorage persistence with schema migration support. Include strict generics, JSDoc examples, and unit test cases using node:test.

prompts.title: Technical Product Launch Narrative & Memo
prompts.body: Write an executive-grade product launch announcement in the style of a clear, high-signal engineering memo. Open with the exact bottleneck developers face today, quantify the latency or workflow tax, introduce our architectural approach without marketing clichés or buzzwords, and walk through 3 concrete before-and-after customer workflows.

prompts.title: Swiss International Typographic Poster Grid
prompts.body: Create a Swiss International Style exhibition poster composition inspired by Josef Müller-Brockmann. Strict asymmetric 12-column modular grid, stark matte off-white archival paper texture (#F4F1EA), deep carbon ink (#141413), and a single International Orange accent (#FF3B00). Geometric kinetic arcs intersecting crisp neo-grotesque typography.

prompts.title: PostgreSQL Query Plan & Index Optimization Audit
prompts.body: Analyze the following PostgreSQL EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) output and table schema. Identify sequential scans, high-cost nested loops, heap fetches, and sort spills. Recommend composite or partial B-Tree/GIN indexes, rewrite correlated subqueries as CTEs or lateral joins, and estimate the I/O reduction.

prompts.title: Industrial Tactile Hardware Product Render
prompts.body: Studio macro product photography of a modular portable synthesizer crafted from bead-blasted anodized aluminum and matte polycarbonate keycaps, inspired by Teenage Engineering and Braun 1960s industrial design. Soft diffused overhead bank lighting, crisp chamfered edges, OLED high-contrast amber matrix display, shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c 120mm macro.
